SELECT
  ((
    (
      SELECT
        t1.balance
      FROM trans AS t1
      WHERE
        t1.account_id = a.account_id AND t1.date = '1993-03-22'
    ) - (
      SELECT
        t2.balance
      FROM trans AS t2
      WHERE
        t2.account_id = a.account_id AND t2.date = '1998-12-27'
    )
  ) / (
    SELECT
      t2.balance
    FROM trans AS t2
    WHERE
      t2.account_id = a.account_id AND t2.date = '1998-12-27'
  )) * 100.0
FROM account AS a
INNER JOIN loan AS l
  ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE
  l.date = '1993-07-05'
ORDER BY
  l.loan_id
LIMIT 1;

WITH SegmentConsumption AS (
  SELECT
    T1.Segment,
    MAX(CASE WHEN T2.Date LIKE '2013%' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE NULL END) AS Consumption_2013,
    MAX(CASE WHEN T2.Date LIKE '2012%' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE NULL END) AS Consumption_2012
  FROM customers AS T1
  INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2
    ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
  WHERE
    T1.Currency = 'EUR' AND (T2.Date LIKE '2012%' OR T2.Date LIKE '2013%')
  GROUP BY
    T1.Segment
)
SELECT
  Segment,
  (Consumption_2013 - Consumption_2012) * 100.0 / Consumption_2013 AS Percentage_Increase
FROM SegmentConsumption
WHERE
  Consumption_2013 IS NOT NULL AND Consumption_2012 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  Percentage_Increase DESC
LIMIT 1
UNION ALL
SELECT
  Segment,
  (Consumption_2013 - Consumption_2012) * 100.0 / Consumption_2013 AS Percentage_Increase
FROM SegmentConsumption
WHERE
  Consumption_2013 IS NOT NULL AND Consumption_2012 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  Percentage_Increase ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  (
    (
      CAST(SUBSTR(T1.time, 1, 2) AS REAL) * 3600 +
      CAST(SUBSTR(T1.time, 4, 2) AS REAL) * 60 +
      CAST(SUBSTR(T1.time, 7, 2) AS REAL) +
      CAST(SUBSTR(T1.time, 10, 3) AS REAL)
    ) - (
      CAST(SUBSTR(T2.time, 1, 2) AS REAL) * 3600 +
      CAST(SUBSTR(T2.time, 4, 2) AS REAL) * 60 +
      CAST(SUBSTR(T2.time, 7, 2) AS REAL) +
      CAST(SUBSTR(T2.time, 10, 3) AS REAL)
    )
  ) * 100.0 / (
    CAST(SUBSTR(T2.time, 1, 2) AS REAL) * 3600 +
    CAST(SUBSTR(T2.time, 4, 2) AS REAL) * 60 +
    CAST(SUBSTR(T2.time, 7, 2) AS REAL) +
    CAST(SUBSTR(T2.time, 10, 3) AS REAL)
  )
FROM lapTimes AS T1
JOIN lapTimes AS T2
  ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId
WHERE
  T1.raceId = (
    SELECT
      raceId
    FROM races
    WHERE
      name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND year = 2008
  ) AND T1.driverId IN (
    SELECT
      driverId
    FROM driverStandings
    WHERE
      raceId = (
        SELECT
          raceId
        FROM races
        WHERE
          name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND year = 2008
      )
    ORDER BY
      position DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AND T2.driverId IN (
    SELECT
      driverId
    FROM driverStandings
    WHERE
      raceId = (
        SELECT
          raceId
        FROM races
          WHERE
          name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND year = 2008
      )
    ORDER BY
      position ASC
    LIMIT 1
  );

  T1.setCode = 'Coldsnap' AND T2.language = 'Italian';

SELECT
  T1.lat,
  T1.lng
FROM circuits AS T1
INNER JOIN races AS T2
  ON T1.circuitId = T2.circuitId
WHERE
  T2.name = 'Malaysian Grand Prix';

SELECT
  T1.Id,
  T1.OwnerDisplayName
FROM posts AS T1
WHERE
  STRFTIME('%Y', T1.CreaionDate) = '2010'
ORDER BY
  T1.FavoriteCount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT
  T1.Time
FROM transactions_1k AS T1
INNER JOIN gasstations AS T2
  ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID
WHERE
  T2.ChainID = 11;

SELECT
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Consumption > 46.73 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
FROM yearmonth AS T1
INNER JOIN customers AS T2
  ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
WHERE
  T2.Segment = 'LAM';

SELECT
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(ID)
FROM Patient
WHERE
  STRFTIME('%Y', Birthday) = '1980' AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT
  T1.id
FROM cards AS T1
INNER JOIN sets AS T2
  ON T1.setCode = T2.code
WHERE
  T1.asciiName = 'Angel of Mercy' AND T2.mtgoCode IS NOT NULL;

SELECT
  T1.Title,
  T1.Body
FROM posts AS T1
INNER JOIN tags AS T2
  ON T1.Id = T2.ExcerptPostId
WHERE
  T2.TagName = 'humor';

SELECT
  T3.time
FROM circuits AS T1
INNER JOIN races AS T2
  ON T1.circuitId = T2.circuitId
INNER JOIN lapTimes AS T3
  ON T2.raceId = T3.raceId
WHERE
  T1.country = 'Italy';

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2
  ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE
  STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) BETWEEN '1936' AND '1956' AND T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.CPK >= 250;

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN T2.DisplayName = 'Mornington' THEN T1.ViewCount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T2.DisplayName = 'Amos' THEN T1.ViewCount ELSE 0 END)
FROM posts AS T1
INNER JOIN users AS T2
  ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id
INNER JOIN posts AS T3
  ON T1.Id = T3.Id
INNER JOIN users AS T4
  ON T3.OwnerUserId = T4.Id
WHERE
  T2.DisplayName IN ('Mornington', 'Amos') AND T4.DisplayName IN ('Mornington', 'Amos');

SELECT
  COUNT(T1.Id)
FROM posts AS T1
INNER JOIN users AS T2
  ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id
WHERE
  T2.DisplayName = 'Tiago Pasqualini';

SELECT
  MAX(T1.Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17))
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2
  ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE
  CAST(T2.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / T2.NumTstTakr > 0.3;

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT T1.driverId)
FROM results AS T1
INNER JOIN races AS T2
  ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId
WHERE
  T2.name = 'Chinese Grand Prix' AND T2.year = 2008;
